candidate_relations.reason: Maternal anti-SSa/Ro and anti-SSb/La antibodies, neonatal bradycardia, and pacemaker placement support neonatal lupus with congenital heart block; however, the benchmark final diagnosis is lupus pneumonitis, reflected by progressive culture-negative respiratory failure and bilateral ground-glass opacities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies neonatal lupus and its cardiac manifestation but omits the requested pulmonary diagnosis of lupus pneumonitis.
